def logarithmic_distance(a: numbers, b: numbers):
    """
    Calculate the logarithmic distance between two numbers.
    This is used for scaling distances in a logarithmic manner.
    """
    # Handle special cases
    if a == b:
        return 0
    
    # Apply logarithmic transformation with offset to avoid log(0)
    # Using the same offset as in numpy_apply_log_keep_sign
    offset = 1e-10
    log_a = math.log(abs(a) + offset) if a != 0 else math.log(offset)
    log_b = math.log(abs(b) + offset) if b != 0 else math.log(offset)
    
    # Calculate the absolute difference of logarithms
    distance = abs(log_a - log_b)
    
    return distance
